question: X, Y and Z invest a sum in the ratio of 16 : 82 : 2, respectively. If they earned a total profit of ₹2,750 at the end of the year, then what is the difference between share of Y and Z?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total investment ratio parts = 16 + 82 + 2 = 100

Difference in ratio parts of Y and Z = 82 − 2 = 80

Since time is the same, profit difference = (80 ÷ 100) × Total Profit

Difference = 0.8 × 2750 = 2200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,200.**
